# Remedence

Remedence is an open-source, API-first security remediation platform focused on independent verification and evidence-backed closure.

## Product rule

A remediation claim is not equivalent to a verified fix. The workflow is:

Remediate -> Verify -> Prove

The v1 local interface uses a fictional Harborline Technology Group dataset and demonstrates a failed first verification for SEC-1042 before a later independent pass.
